controls.zh: 《Bandit》现为多人版《Vault Breakers》。金库模式至少需要两人，可创建或加入房间。原作支持键鼠和标准手柄。
controls.en: Bandit is now Vault Breakers. Heist needs at least two players. Create or join a room. Play with keyboard and mouse or a standard gamepad.

controls.zh: 点鱼车，把车尾相连的同色鱼放进环形管道。鱼会自动进入车尾同色且有空位的车，没有匹配的车时可进入空车。
controls.en: Click or tap a bus to send its tail group of same-colour fish into the pipe. Fish board buses with a matching tail and room. If none match, they can enter an empty bus.

controls.zh: 在「NOIR CITY」标题页开始，进入《NOIR EXTREME》第一章餐馆。WASD 移动、鼠标观察、E 交互。支持标准手柄。
controls.en: Start from the NOIR CITY title screen to enter the original NOIR EXTREME diner chapter. Move with WASD, look with the mouse and interact with E. Standard gamepads are supported.

controls.zh: 方向键或 WASD 驾驶，S 爬升，W 俯冲。空格喷漆，长按蓄力，E、Q 换挡。
controls.en: Steer with the arrows or WASD. S climbs and W dives. Press or hold Space to paint, and shift gears with E or Q.

controls.zh: 选标题页第一项开始、续玩或重玩，再选「ROW OUT」出航。移动指针划船，靠近微光收集。点击或按空格放出灯火，Esc 回岸。
controls.en: Choose the first title-menu option to start, continue or replay, then ROW OUT. Move the pointer to row near wisps and collect them. Click or press Space to flare. Esc returns to shore.

zh: 大田都市科学高中专业探索
en: Daejeon Urban Science High School Department Tour

controls.zh: 选「입장하기」参观学校，「미니게임」体验小游戏。点击、空格或回车推进韩语对白，选「시작」开始小游戏。
controls.en: Choose 입장하기 for the campus tour or 미니게임 for minigames. Click, press Space or Enter to advance Korean dialogue. 시작 starts the selected minigame.
